verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes its own API reference: a generated endpoint/schema reference (/llms-api.txt), a canonical OpenAPI document with 174 paths, and a Developer MCP server that lets AI assistants search and read the API reference live. Guides include working request examples (e.g. a working POST /bills request), and a sandbox API base exists for safe execution. However, nothing documents an interactive, in-browser API explorer with "try it"/runnable examples; the rendered docs are only described as JavaScript shells. Missing for 10: documented interactive try-it console in the API reference, runnable examples embedded per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of an interactive reference experience.
